question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_runs), 2) as average_total_runs
FROM (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.striker as player_id, bb.striker_batting_position as batting_position, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker, bb.striker_batting_position
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) > 50 AND bb.striker_batting_position IN (1, 2)
) sub
